verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a built-in AI agent that takes actions on request. In Slack you can mention @Rootly with requests like "page the database on-call team", "Update the incident severity" or "convert this to a private incident". AI SRE autonomously investigates alerts and incidents and recommends next steps, and AI Instructions steer how Rootly Agents carry out tasks. A conversational agent is also available on mobile. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation, and action-taking in the web app chat (documented as read-only).
